G5000.name: Tabitha
G5000.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G5000.brief: Charitable woman in Joppa whom Peter raised from the dead
G5000.short: Tabitha, also called Dorcas, was a beloved disciple in Joppa known for her charitable works, whom Peter raised from the dead.

G5060.name: Tertius
G5060.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G5060.brief: Paul's scribe who wrote the Epistle to the Romans
G5060.short: Tertius served as Paul's scribe, writing down the Epistle to the Romans.

G5061.name: Tertullus
G5061.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G5061.brief: Lawyer who accused Paul before Governor Felix
G5061.short: Tertullus was a lawyer hired by the Jewish authorities to accuse Paul before the Roman governor Felix.

G5086.name: Tiberius
G5086.desc: Emperor living at the time of the New Testament
G5086.brief: Roman emperor during Jesus' ministry and death
G5086.short: Tiberius was the Roman emperor during Jesus' ministry and crucifixion, mentioned in several Gospel accounts.

G5090.name: Timaeus
G5090.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G5090.brief: Father of Bartimaeus, a blind man healed by Jesus
G5090.short: Timaeus was the father of Bartimaeus, a blind beggar who was healed by Jesus near Jericho.

G5096.name: Timon
G5096.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G5096.brief: One of the seven chosen to serve the church
G5096.short: Timon was one of the seven men chosen by the apostles to oversee the daily distribution of food to widows in the early church.

G5095G.name: Timothy
G5095G.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G5095G.short: Timothy was a young disciple and co-worker of Paul, who accompanied him on his missionary journeys and later served as a pastor.

G5019.name: Tarsus
G5019.brief: City in Cilicia, birthplace of the apostle Paul
G5019.short: Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, known as the birthplace and early residence of the apostle Paul (<ref="Act.9.11, 30; 21:39; 22:3">Act.9.11, 30; 21:39; 22:3</ref>).
